title: Sandcastle Knight
author: Claude
blurb: A thumb-sized tin knight takes back a backyard sandbox from ants, crabs, beetles, a running hose, the tide, and one very large tabby cat. Build towers of sand to raise the gates!

box.tagline: Hold the sandbox. Build the towers. Beware the cat.
box.back:
Summer, 1995. Lady Whiskerbane, the tabby from next door, has flattened every castle in the backyard sandbox. Ants dig through Anthill Keep, the hose floods the moat, crabs rule the tide pool and beetles hold the burrow beneath it all.

Sir Grit is a tin knight no taller than your thumb, with a red plume and a toy shovel. Scoop sand, dig through dunes, plug anthills, fill fords and build tower after tower until the gates rise. Ride the hose currents, outrun crumbling bridges, time the tide, and splash the biggest cat you have ever seen.
features: Five castles and a whole sandbox to roam, plus a secret dial-up to THE -= S A N D B O X =- BBS
Sand is everything: dig it, carry it, build towers with it, fill moats and plug anthills
Hose currents, crumbling bridges, rolling waves and a tidal flat that floods
Pack walls of wet sand to trap patrolling crabs
A boss cat six blocks wide, with paws you must splash back
VGA graphics and PC speaker sound effects - no sound card needed
